description: How many steps each job of scripts/drive-all.js must report. A driver that quietly runs fewer steps (or a scenario that lost some) fails the run. Change a number only together with the scenario or the driver that changed it, in the same pull request. 'probe' is the 27 checks of drive-probe.js; the other jobs are driver:scenario, the scenario's steps plus the steps the driver adds (stdio: handshake, shutdown and the stdout check; http: ready, health, auth, handshake, metrics and shutdown; bundle: the package, the data and the lock checks).
